answer: Astra replicates each secret across three parties so any two can reconstruct a share, and the river of the design is that the third party acts as a witness against cheating. The crystal of the protocol is that multiplication uses the replicated structure to stay in one round, which makes joint identity checks fast. A Sybil operator controlling one of the three servers learns nothing, and a terrace of fake identities cannot pass because the honest parties cross-check every replicated share.
